name: lessthanweb VAT ID Checker
author: lessthanweb

sections.description:
Add optional VAT country and VAT ID fields to WooCommerce Classic Checkout or Checkout Block, and let customers update their VAT ID in My Account. The plugin checks VAT IDs with the European Commission’s VIES service.

Tax removal depends on your store’s settings and the rules for the customer’s country. By default, customers taxed in your store’s base country still pay tax, and an invalid VAT ID never removes tax. If VIES cannot check an ID, you choose whether checkout can continue; an unverified ID is not treated as invalid, and tax stays on by default. Customers must confirm they are authorized to use a VAT ID from a different country than their billing address before tax can be removed.

Store owners can review VAT ID checks with each order, including the submitted ID, result, check time, and billing country. When available, order details also show the customer’s IP address and country. Customer VAT details are included in privacy exports and removed when account data is erased. Order records follow your store’s WooCommerce retention and erasure settings. The plugin also provides suggested privacy-policy text.

To check a VAT ID, the plugin sends its country code and number to the European Commission’s VIES service. The customer’s IP address is not sent to VIES. See the VIES information and its privacy notice.

You can choose whether checkout shows the company name and address returned by VIES after a valid check. These details appear only during checkout and are not saved to customer or order records. Choose whether checkout fields appear with the order details or billing address. Checkout Block address fields appear in both billing and shipping sections.

Optional integrations can add the saved VAT ID to invoices created with PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce by WP Overnight or YITH WooCommerce PDF Invoice & Shipping List. Both are off by default, and you can customize the invoice label.

You can also choose to show a Tax/VAT line when the amount is zero, including at checkout and in order totals and emails.

Troubleshooting logs keep up to 100 entries for 30 days and do not include full VAT IDs or customer IP addresses.

This plugin is not tax or legal advice. Check your tax settings and VAT treatment with a qualified tax advisor or accountant.

This free edition includes VAT ID checks and tax handling. The optional Pro edition adds reporting and workflow tools for stores managing larger volumes of checks.

Upgrade to Pro

Upgrade to lessthanweb VAT ID Checker Pro to add tools for handling verification work across your store:

  • Scheduled rechecks and retry controls for eligible unresolved verification results, with configurable intervals and retry limits.
  • A filterable recheck queue to review and bulk recheck selected orders, with bounded processing and clear results.
  • Filtered reports and CSV exports for verification outcomes, unresolved work, and repeat verification history.
  • VIES failure alerts when service failures meet your configured threshold.
  • Country-specific tax retention to keep normal taxes for selected customer tax destinations, even when a VAT ID is valid.
  • Cross-country risk review to compare the VAT country, billing country, and locally available IP geolocation country. These comparisons are staff review signals only; Pro does not show the customer’s IP address or change VAT validity, checkout, or tax decisions.

Pro is a separate add-on and requires this free plugin to remain active.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8 or later.
  • PHP 8.3 or later.
  • WooCommerce 8.9 or later.
  • Tested with WooCommerce 11.2.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lessthanweb-vat-id-checker folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate lessthanweb VAT ID Checker and WooCommerce.
  3. Open WooCommerce > Vat ID to choose how checkout behaves when VIES is unavailable.
  4. Test the store’s tax configuration with a qualified tax advisor before relying on tax removal.
sections.faq:
What happens when VIES is unavailable?

The store administrator chooses whether checkout may continue with the VAT ID marked unverified or must wait until VIES responds. An outage is never treated as proof that an ID is invalid. Tax is retained for unverified IDs by default; the separate setting to remove tax for unverified IDs is off by default.

Does a valid VAT ID always remove tax?

No. Tax removal depends on the store’s tax configuration and eligibility conditions. By default, a domestic customer whose WooCommerce taxable country matches the store’s base country keeps normal taxes, but the Keep tax for domestic VAT IDs setting can be disabled if the store’s rules require otherwise. For eligible cross-border destinations, a VAT-country/billing-country mismatch also requires customer authorization. A confirmed-invalid ID never removes tax.

Which checkout types are supported?

The plugin supports WooCommerce Classic Checkout and Checkout Block, as well as VAT ID display and updates in My Account.

Where can I review verification results or troubleshoot problems?

Open WooCommerce > Vat ID. Overview shows the configured checkout flow and verification counts. Verification history shows the latest result for each order, while the order’s VAT ID panel shows earlier attempts. Users who can edit an order can ask VIES to check its saved VAT ID again; this adds a new result but does not change the order’s taxes. Overview > Logs lists technical diagnostic reasons and keeps up to 100 entries for 30 days.

Can I change where the checkout VAT fields appear?

Yes. The fields can appear in order details or in the billing address section. The Checkout Block API places address fields in both billing and shipping sections.

Can I show company details returned by VIES?

Yes. Enable the setting to show the returned company name and address after a valid check. Some member states do not return these details; they are not saved to customer or order records.

Which invoice plugins are supported?

The plugin has optional integrations for PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce by WP Overnight and YITH WooCommerce PDF Invoice & Shipping List. Both integrations are disabled by default and use the saved VAT ID and configurable label.

What data is sent to VIES?

Only the submitted VAT country prefix and VAT number are sent to the European Commission VIES service for verification. The customer IP address is not sent to VIES.

How are VAT details exported or erased?

Current customer VAT data is included in WordPress personal-data exports and is removed by the plugin’s account-data eraser. Order snapshots are handled through WooCommerce order privacy tools and follow the store’s normal order-retention and erasure policy.

Does the plugin provide tax advice?

No. Store owners must ask a qualified tax advisor or accountant to review their tax settings and VAT treatment.
